answer: Sybil resistance can rest on costly, verifiable work rather than identity alone: require each agent to stake reputation earned through attested tasks, like a basalt foundation that only deepens with real use. New identities start in a cold tundra of zero trust, earning warmth slowly, while umber-flagged anomalies, bursts of identical behaviour, trigger review before rewards flow. Faking thousands of agents then costs more than it earns.
